==Description==
'''Coin Ride''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] premium track. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

Upon use, the player will ride on a carousel-like machine, consisting of a mechanical white horse with red, gold, black and yellow armor.

This emote was obtainable at Level 26 of the Spring Frenzy Battle Pass premium track, which cost {{Bunz|860}} or {{Robux|127}}. The total cost is {{Bunz|10,670}} or {{Robux|2,197}}.
